root_domain.definition: A finite, schema-validated object inside a bounded virtual volume. Each object has total boolean traits used by the local delta where it is classified.
root_domain.prototype_scope: Matter taxonomy from the project materials, plus a bounded symbolic unfolding from particle counts to selected atoms, compounds, and functional classes.

graph TD

decider.name: decide_continuous
decider.termination: O(1): one schema validation and one boolean read.

obligations.total: For every x in VirtualMatterObject, x.traits.continuous is present and boolean.
obligations.exclusive: A boolean value cannot be both true and false.
obligations.termination: The decider performs a bounded finite read.

invariants: Exactly one branch is appended to the classification path.

evidence_source.claim: Материя splits into continuous field and discontinuous particles.

decider.name: decide_grouped
decider.termination: O(1): one schema validation and one boolean read.

obligations.total: For every x in Particles, x.traits.grouped is present and boolean.
obligations.exclusive: Grouped(x) and not Grouped(x) are complementary boolean cases.
obligations.termination: The decider performs a bounded finite read.

invariants: x is already classified as Particles.
Grouped and not Grouped cannot both be active.

evidence_source.claim: Particles split into grouped particle groups and ungrouped free particles.

decider.name: decide_planetary
decider.termination: O(1): one schema validation and one boolean read.

obligations.total: For every x in GroupsOfParticles, x.traits.planetary is present and boolean.
obligations.exclusive: Planetary(x) and not Planetary(x) are complementary boolean cases.
obligations.termination: The decider performs a bounded finite read.

invariants: x is already classified as GroupsOfParticles.
Planetary and not Planetary cannot both be active.

evidence_source.claim: Grouped particles split into planetary subparticles and non-planetary substance.
